headline: AMARI PORTRAIT CALIBRATION.
deck: Framing check: preserve face, dress and African cultural context without crowding.
quote: Context is not decoration; it carries memory and meaning.
facts: Keep the full face comfortably inside the portrait frame.
Retain enough shoulder and clothing detail to preserve character identity.
Keep the character-specific background context visible where useful.
Avoid edge pressure, accidental cropping and unnecessary zoom.
takeaway: Lock the crop only when identity and cultural context remain balanced.
